description: Source code for the Bernoulli distribution class in PyTorch, implementing probabilistic sampling, log probability, entropy, and support enumeration.

classes.name: Bernoulli
classes.description: A class representing the Bernoulli distribution, supporting sampling, probability calculations, and distribution properties.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a Bernoulli distribution with probs or logits, ensuring only one is specified.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the distribution parameters to a new batch shape.

methods.name: _new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the distribution with given parameters.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Returns the mean (probability of success) of the distribution.

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the distribution, with special handling for 0.5 probabilities.

methods.name: variance
methods.description: Calculates the variance of the Bernoulli distribution.

methods.name: logits
methods.description: Lazy property converting probs to logits.

methods.name: probs
methods.description: Lazy property converting logits to probs.

methods.name: param_shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the distribution parameters.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates samples from the Bernoulli distribution.

methods.name: log_prob
methods.description: Calculates the log probability of given values.

methods.name: entropy
methods.description: Calculates the entropy of the distribution.

methods.name: _natural_params
methods.description: Returns the natural parameters of the distribution.

methods.name: _log_normalizer
methods.description: Computes the log normalizer for the distribution.
